proposed_decision.rule: Govern PAR-, VAM-/VAMA- and SAR- as nonproductive analytical semantic clusters only. They describe distributional families in the audited lexicon but are not standalone roots, morphemes or derivational rules.

VAM-/VAMA-.domain: broad identity / preference / leisure / personal-activity association

governance_decisions.proposal: Do not create PAR, VAM, VAMA or SAR as standalone lexical entries under B10.
Do not license any new PAR-, VAM-/VAMA- or SAR- derivation; productivity remains NONE.
Do not infer unrecovered meanings from family membership, including SAROSAL or any other glossless form.
Preserve B7 -VAN and B8 PARAZAMO/PARAZAMI as more specific governed analyses and B9 final-I as a distributional tendency; B10 does not widen any of them.
B10 changes no lexical authority, individual word semantics, grammar, productivity, or curriculum slots.

approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-B10-001 through DEC-B10-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not approve B11, create any family root/morpheme, or infer any unrecovered gloss.
